record_identity.title: NTB withdrew Telenor security story after AI-generated fabricated quotes

incident_identity.historical_event_name: NTB withdrew Telenor security story after AI-generated fabricated quotes
incident_identity.date_basis: Journalisten reports that NTB published and withdrew the article on 15 October 2025.

summary: Norwegian news agency NTB withdrew an article after an external AI writing tool introduced five fabricated quotations and a nonexistent Telenor source title into copy that was syndicated to some publishers.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Journalisten reported that NTB published the article on 15 October and withdrew it the same morning after Telenor raised the errors. NTB identified five quotations that had not been said and a security-director title that did not exist. The journalist had used an external AI tool contrary to internal policy; NTB initiated an internal review.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: Generated material was propagated as publishable reporting without the verification needed for attributed quotations and source identity. The failure combined miscalibrated reliance, omitted checking and false source attribution.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: The case demonstrates that professional publication controls must verify quotations and attributed identities independently of fluent generated copy, especially before syndication.
assessment_boundaries: The source establishes publication and same-day withdrawal but not the audience size or every downstream republication.
The record does not infer which model produced the fabricated text.
